native_sites.role: Shared type-specific biased Q/K/V/output linear maps, optional affine LayerNorm, relation attention/message/prior and sigmoid skip parameters; native dropout defaults to 0.2.
Input a_m before source V map at line69 only; Q/K lines68/70 still receive member hidden states with unmodulated native shared Q/K maps.
Relation r selected by constant edge id. Output b_m+c_m*q_r*u after bmm at line50, before return. Channel factor reshape (1,H,d/H); no relocation before relation transform.
Attention softmax over neighbors within each relation, weighted sum, flatten, cross-relation mean, biased typed output, sigmoid residual mix, optional norm then dropout unchanged.
Biased input adapters plus tanh; n_layers full HGT recurrences; shared biased classifier.

affine_operation: val_mr = reshape(((h_m * a_m) @ V_t + nu_t), H,d/H) @ R_r; then val_mr *= reshape(b_m + c_m*q_r*u,H,d/H).
effective_linear_part: h_m D(a_m) V_t blockdiag(R_r) D(b_mr), with native V bias transformed by R_r and scaled by b_mr too.
bias_convention: Input scale does not multiply native V bias; output scale acts on the complete affine relation value including transformed V bias. Bias stays shared. This binds the native affine extension of the saved linear formula.
head_order: Native view(-1,n_heads,d_k) followed by view(-1,out_dim); output u/b use that flattened head-major order. d divisible by8 required.
canonical_relation_rule: Canonical (source type, raw released relation ID, target type), with a unique etype name containing raw relation ID. Reverse directions remain separate. Same-type citation/reference relations are eligible; non-self excludes synthetic self-loop relation types, not all equal-endpoint types. Native HGT adds no synthetic self relation.
graph_and_private_state: Immutable topology/features can be shared. Each route must reset input adapters from the original features and retain distinct h/Q/K/V/edge-attention/message/scratch frames and dropout RNG. Use explicit route-bound factors and isolated graph local frames; no hidden-state overwrite or detached message cache. Shared core parameters receive mean own-member CE gradients.
current_layer_attention: No direct CP scale on query/key/attention branch. Attention may differ indirectly through each member recurrent state.
served_pool: Arithmetic mean raw member logits; then softmax (and separately prebound common validation-only scalar temperature if adopted).
same_site_diagonal_adapter_equivalence: Input activation diagonal immediately before V and output activation diagonal immediately after R implements the identical affine operator; no separate comparator needed to certify a different method.
forbidden_substitutions: Do not use run_hgt.py as HGT: it imports/constructs myGAT
Do not replace HGB model.py with original pyHGT: attention normalization, GELU and dropout/norm order differ
Do not multiply after nonlinear/skip/norm/classifier or modulate Q/K; those change the fixed operation

init_binding.q: Balanced generic +/-1 per layer over canonical relations (DBLP source schema R6); generic seed pending parent qualification
init_binding.unrestricted_output_init: Materialize the full b_mr table from CP initial values; match initial function and all other streams, disclose coordinate/weight-decay differences
init_binding.c0_null: c0 with nonzero q/u and identical routes gives zero q/u product gradients and possibly identical c gradients
init_binding.q0_antithetic_null: q0 with sum(c)=0 and identical route response cancels pooled q gradient; other product gradients vanish

claim_limit: Fixed effective coefficient rank<=2 versus global BE rank<=1 across member x relation. Complete HGT function-class superiority and predictive benefit do not follow.
